hero.title: Hi, I'm Kike.
hero.tagline: I make websites. The bugs are unintentional.

about.label: 01 — About
about.text: When I'm not coding, I'm usually playing football, at the gym or out for a run, almost always with music on. And whenever I get a few days off, I pack a bag and go somewhere new. I'm good at working in a team and communicating: I'd rather bring up a problem early than fix it late. I like learning new things and keeping up with what's coming out, and if something catches my eye I end up tinkering with it in some project.

stack.label: 02 — Stack
stack.text: I'm fresh out of my Web Development degree with 9 months of real work under my belt. I'm comfortable on both sides: interfaces in React and servers in Node, Java or PHP, with databases that don't break (almost never). I quickly pick up whatever tools each team uses, and I like to suggest improvements.
